API GETs across the whole study: 5 (plus 1 failed /api/products/<id> attempt). Saved verbatim from fetcher output; trimmed to meta + 1 sample item per probe.

probe_A_niche_keyword.finding: total_count = 1065 (non-round) for a niche long-tail keyword => real count passthrough; no universal 2000 floor.

probe_B_page_clamp.finding: Requested page 101, response says page:100 with has_next_page:false => hard clamp at 100 pages / 2000 results. This matches 1688's NATIVE search cap (~2000 per keyword, per sourabhbgp/1688-scraper store docs) => Soorce passes upstream cap through, another raw-passthrough signal.
probe_B_page_clamp.extra_observation: is_ad:true items appear even on page 100 — ads frozen deep in the result set (live 1688 search ranks ads on page 1) — consistent with stable/frozen ordering per page fetch.

probe_C_default_feed_no_keyword.finding: A SECOND raw upstream shape flows through the same endpoint ununified => thin custom middleware doing raw passthrough; rules out a single normalized internal DB and a commercial normalized API for the search layer.

counter_drift_evidence.offer: ph值测试仪ph测试笔… (ph test pen)
counter_drift_evidence.interpretation: Counters MOVED between two fetches while USD price stayed fixed => search layer is live/near-live from upstream; Soorce pricing layer is precomputed/cached. CONFIRMED hybrid.

pricing_margin_pairs.method: tier-1 quantity_prices CNY (begin_num == quantity_begin) vs headline USD price; 12 matched pairs across probes A/B + capture A
pricing_margin_pairs.interpretation: Effective conversion 4.62–5.64 vs market ~7.2 => baked-in service margin ≈ +28%…+56%, regressive (falls as price rises). Probable — assumes headline derives from tier-1; per-item variation suggests a pricing engine, not a flat rate. CONFIRMS price_info is Soorce's own layer on top of raw CNY tiers.

sitemap_index_probe.note: All 26 child sitemaps carry ONE uniform lastmod => catalog layer regenerated together on a recurring cadence. Server date appears 2 days ahead of session date (2026-11-26 local) — recorded as-is, cause unknown (build stamp bug or clock).

provider_fingerprint_comparison.conclusion: NO verbatim field-name match with any surveyed documented output. Soorce preserves raw 1688 web-shaped fields (UI badges) under its own names; source vendor unidentified and NOT provable externally. Official open.1688.com API ruled out (Probable-high): it does not return web-UI badge fields nor leak internal offer-widget JSON.
